title: Hyper aggregate file
description: hyper.json, the root of an Aggregate directory. It carries the one fact the directory cannot say for itself, which Space is Meta (ADR 0078). There is no list of Spaces: a Space is in the aggregate because its directory is there. Strict: no other key is allowed.

version.description: The aggregate file's own version, versioned apart from space.json. Any other value is refused, not migrated.

metaSpaceId.description: The Meta Space's Id. Intake checks that a Space directory of that name exists.
